national_news.title: Government Approves Continuation of PM-KISAN Scheme till 2030-31
bullets: The Central Government has approved the continuation of the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) scheme for a five-year period from 2026-27 to 2030-31.
Launched in 2019, PM-KISAN provides eligible farmers with financial assistance of Rs 6,000 per year in three equal installments via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) and Aadhaar authentication.
Over Rs 4.47 lakh crore has been disbursed across 23 installments to date, benefiting more than 9.49 crore farmers, including over Rs 1.6 lakh crore transferred to women farmers.

national_news.title: India and Japan Conduct Joint Air Exercise 'Veer Guardian 2026' in Jodhpur
bullets: Indian Air Force (IAF) Chief Air Chief Marshal AP Singh and Japan Air Self-Defense Force (JASDF) Chief General Takehiro Morita flew together in the indigenous Light Combat Aircraft (LCA) Tejas during 'Veer Guardian 2026'.
Marks the first time Japanese fighter aircraft (F-2A) operated from Indian soil during a bilateral exercise.
The 14-day exercise featured advanced operational missions involving IAF's Tejas, Su-30MKI, and Rafale alongside Japan's F-2A fighter jets.

national_news.title: President Murmu Emphasizes Community-Led Climate Action at Environment Conference
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu addressed the valedictory session of the 'Future of Environment and Climate Dynamics' conference in New Delhi.
Highlighted the role of India's 'Mission LiFE' initiative and traditional community knowledge in fostering climate adaptation and ecological restoration.
Commended the National Green Tribunal (NGT) for its pivotal role in establishing effective compliance frameworks for air quality, waste management, and river preservation.

national_news.title: IWAI Showcases Bogibeel IWT Terminal Infrastructure along National Waterway-2
bullets: The Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI) highlighted operational capabilities at the Bogibeel IWT Terminal on National Waterway-2 (Brahmaputra River).
The terminal features an annual cargo handling capacity of 6 lakh MT and supports Over-Dimensional Cargo (ODC) movement for the Numaligarh Refinery expansion.
NW-2 spans 891 km from the Bangladesh border to Sadiya, with recent customs and immigration additions at Bogibeel and Dhubri boosting the Indo-Bangladesh Protocol Route.

national_news.title: Union Sports Minister Leads 91st 'Sundays on Cycle' Event in Nagoya
bullets: Union Minister of Youth Affairs & Sports Mansukh Mandaviya led the 91st edition of 'Sundays on Cycle' at Meijo Park in Nagoya, Japan.
Organized under the Fit India Movement by MYAS in collaboration with the Cycling Federation of India, Raahgiri Foundation, and MY Bharat.
The initiative aimed to engage the Indian diaspora to support the 500+ Indian contingent competing in the Asian Games 2026.

national_news.title: Indian Air Force to Host Three-Day Air Show Over River Ganges in Varanasi
bullets: The Indian Air Force (IAF) is scheduled to organize a three-day aerial display over the River Ganges in Varanasi from October 22 to 25.
Over three dozen aircraft will participate, including Rafale and Tejas fighter jets, C-295 transport planes, Rudra helicopters, Dakota aircraft, and the Suryakiran aerobatic team.
The air show will span across 84 ghats from Namo Ghat to Assi Ghat, with Namo Ghat acting as the central control hub for operations.

national_news.title: Rashtriya Sankalp Samaroh Organized Under Nasha Mukt Yuva Abhiyan
bullets: The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports organized the Rashtriya Sankalp Samaroh across 1,067 locations nationwide to eradicate drug abuse among youth.
The event is part of the 'Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat- 100 Weeks Nasha Mukt Yuva Abhiyan'.
Activities included the Nasha Mukt Pledge, signature campaigns, thematic street plays, and youth-led discussions across 471 District MY Bharat Offices and partner organizations.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Delegation Studies UP's Digital Sugarcane Management System
bullets: A three-member delegation from Bihar visited Lucknow to inspect Uttar Pradesh's Smart Sugarcane Farmer Portal and the 'e-Ganna' app.
The study focuses on ground-level implementation of digital sugarcane surveys, supply estimates, transparent cane slip distribution, and real-time payment tracking.
Bihar aims to adopt these digital best practices to establish time-bound online grievance redressal mechanisms for its sugarcane farmers.

bihar_news.title: ICC Global Business Summit 2026 Focuses on Eastern India's Growth Corridor
bullets: The ICC Global Business Summit 2026 commenced in New Delhi under the theme 'Reinventing Global Business: Growth, Risk & Resilience'.
Ministers from Assam, West Bengal, and Bihar presented investment potential in line with the Central Government's 'Purvodaya' vision for Eastern India.
The summit showcased key regional industrial advancements, including semiconductor assembly projects, multi-modal logistics hubs, and renewable energy infrastructure targets.

bihar_news.title: Surge in Demand for Bihar's GI-Tagged 'Marcha Chuda'
bullets: Marcha Chuda, an aromatic flattened rice from West Champaran district of Bihar, has seen a sharp surge in national and international demand following its Geographical Indication (GI) tag.
Cultivated using traditional organic methods without chemical fertilizers, the paddy features a distinctive black peppercorn-like shape from which it derives the name 'Marcha'.

The crop cultivation starts during the Sawan month and matures for harvest by late November, significantly boosting farm incomes and driving exports to states such as UP, West Bengal, Odisha, and Uttarakhand.

bihar_news.title: West Bengal Launches 'Seva First' Innovation Challenge for Eastern Zone
bullets: The West Bengal government launched the 'Seva First Innovation Challenge – Eastern Zone' inviting innovators from West Bengal, Bihar, and Jharkhand.
The initiative is organized by the Department of Science & Technology and Biotechnology (DSTBT) under the 'Seva Sankalp Abhiyan 2026'.
Focus areas include healthcare access, agricultural losses, water shortages, waste management, and disaster preparedness across two categories (Junior and Open).

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government to Implement Pay Scale for Non-Financed Education Workers
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister announced the implementation of a pay scale for non-financed education workers and teachers, with a committee headed by the Chief Secretary already working on it.
The state government has disbursed Rs 18,000 crore through the Student Credit Card scheme to support higher education.
A total of 700 model schools currently cater to 3.5 lakh children, while 1.42 lakh students are being taught through the Vidyarthi Saathi app.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Chief Minister Inaugurates 'Viksit Bihar' Brainstorming Session
bullets: Chief Minister Samrat Chaudhory inaugurated the 'Viksit Bihar: Foundation to Construction' brainstorming session at Bapu Sabhagar in Patna.
Highlighting financial growth, Bihar's 2024 budget reached Rs 3.17 lakh crore, surpassing Jharkhand's budget of Rs 1.39 lakh crore.
Key initiatives highlighted include 700 model schools, academic sessions in 211 degree colleges, and the 'Vidyarthi Saathi' app for digital learning.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Approves Rs 3,516 Crore Infrastructure Package for Gaya's Sacred Geography
bullets: The Bihar government approved a Rs 3,516 crore infrastructure package on September 15, 2026, to boost religious tourism and the pilgrimage economy in Gaya.

The package includes the Rs 2,520 crore redevelopment of the Vishnupad Temple precinct along the lines of Varanasi's Kashi Vishwanath Corridor, implemented by the Bihar State Road Development Corporation.
It also includes a Rs 996.05 crore project to link the Son and Falgu rivers to address water challenges in the region.
Provisional tourism data for January-July 2026 recorded 1.14 million domestic and 96,465 foreign visitors in Gaya, alongside 1.46 million domestic and 134,000 foreign visitors in Bodh Gaya.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Health Department Directs 100% Digital OPD Registration in Government Hospitals
bullets: The Bihar Health Department directed all government hospitals to ensure 100 per cent digital registration of patients in outpatient departments (OPDs) using ABHA-based registration and electronic health records (EHRs).
During a review meeting chaired by Health Secretary Kumar Ravi, mandatory registration through the Bhavya portal was also instituted for patients admitted to inpatient departments.

The department reviewed key health initiatives, including the TB-Free Bihar and Anaemia-Free Bihar campaigns, maternal and child healthcare, and upgradation plans for district and community health centres.

bihar_news.title: Chief Minister Samrat Chaudhory Highlights Bihar's Economic and Educational Growth
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Chaudhory inaugurated the 'Viksit Bihar: Foundation to Construction' brainstorming session and 'Lav-Kush Pratibha Samman Samaroh' in Patna.
Highlighted the state's budget growth, stating Bihar's 2024 budget reached Rs 3.17 lakh crore, surpassing Jharkhand's Rs 1.39 lakh crore budget.
Informed that academic sessions commenced in 211 degree colleges simultaneously on July 15, with 700 model schools and 75,000 teachers connected via the 'Vidyarthi Saathi' app.
